tools.name: make_video
tools.title: Make a video
tools.description: Make a short video clip from a prompt, with optional reference pictures (a person, a product, a room, a first frame) and voice clips (audio_urls). Best for ads, product shots, UGC-style clips. Building references for a Seedance model? Read diffusr://guides/seedance-references first. Costs credits (1 credit = $0.01) — pass dry_run: true first: its price is the most you pay. Returns an id straight away; call get_result with it until the file is ready. A local file needs upload_asset first. Every call is a fresh take and bills again. An answer with warnings (e.g. the quoted lines need a longer duration_sec) means fix the request before you spend.

prompt.description: The shot: subject, action, camera, setting, sound.

image_urls.description: Optional reference pictures (a person, a product, a room, a first frame). Say in the prompt what each one is, by its place in this list — on Seedance: "Image 1 is Mia, the speaker". Public URLs — upload_asset gives you one for a local file.

audio_urls.description: Optional voice or sound clips (models with takes_audio in list_models — the Seedance family). E.g. 5–10 s of the speaker's voice cut from an earlier clip, so the next clip keeps that voice. Name each in the prompt: "Audio 1 is Mia's voice". Public URLs.

duration_sec.description: Length in seconds. Leave out for the model's default.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. "9:16", "16:9", "1:1". Leave out for the model's default.

resolution.description: e.g. "720p". Leave out for the model's default.

model.description: Leave out for the recommended model. Ids come from list_models.

dry_run.description: true = only check the request and return the price in credits. Nothing is made, nothing is spent.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string you make up for this request. Retry with the same key and you get the first result back instead of paying again.

callback_url.description: Optional. A public https:// link. When the job finishes (done, failed or canceled) we POST the finished result here, signed. See the docs for checking the signature. Polling get_result still works.

tools.name: recast
tools.title: Recast a video
tools.description: Take an existing clip and put new people, products or places into it, keeping its motion, camera and timing. Give the clip as video_url, photos of who or what should appear as image_urls, and a mode ("world" = rebuild everything from the photos, "swap" = replace just the main subject) or your own prompt. The default model takes clips up to 10 s and allows real people. The result keeps the clip's own sound (voice, music) — the model only remakes the picture. Costs credits (1 credit = $0.01) — pass dry_run: true first: its price is the most you pay. Returns an id straight away; call get_result with it until the file is ready. A local file needs upload_asset first.

video_url.description: The source clip, an MP4 or MOV link (upload_asset gives one). Its motion, camera and timing are kept. At most 10 s on the default model (30 s on seedance-2-5): a longer clip is refused before anything is spent, so trim it first. Its real length is read from the file and is what you are priced on.

image_urls.description: Photos of who or what should appear in the clip.

mode.description: "world" = same motion, new people, place and look from the photos. "swap" = replace the main subject with the first photo, keep the rest. Use this OR prompt.

prompt.description: Your own instruction instead of a mode. Say the change, then what to keep.

duration_sec.description: Ignored. The output length follows your clip's real length, read from video_url (rounded, within the model's range). It is also what you are priced on.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. "9:16", "16:9", "1:1". Leave out for the model's default.

resolution.description: e.g. "720p". Leave out for the model's default.

tools.name: make_music
tools.title: Make a song
tools.description: Make an original song from a prompt: an ad soundtrack, a jingle, background music. About a minute long (a length in the prompt is only a hint), with sung lyrics unless it says "Instrumental only, no vocals." Write your own lyrics with [Verse] / [Chorus] tags, or let it write them. Named artists' voices and copyrighted lyrics are refused. The result is an mp3 (output.kind AUDIO). Costs credits (1 credit = $0.01) — pass dry_run: true first: its price is the most you pay. Returns an id straight away; call get_result with it until the file is ready.

prompt.description: The song: genre, mood, instruments, tempo, and what it is for. Add lyrics with [Verse] / [Chorus] tags, or say "Instrumental only, no vocals." Lyria picks the length (about a minute); a length in words is only a hint.

dry_run.description: true = only check the request and return the price in credits. Nothing is made, nothing is spent.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string you make up for this request. Retry with the same key and you get the first result back instead of paying again.

tools.name: run_template
tools.title: Run a template
tools.description: Run one of diffusr's templates as ONE call: a product ad, a video template (make one like it, or swap its people), a one-person talking head or a two-host podcast up to 30 s. Pick the id from list_templates, which says what each needs. Talking head and podcast: write the script word for word and pass photos of the people. Animation, story, song and longer films are not here: use make_image and make_video. Costs credits (1 credit = $0.01) — pass dry_run: true first: its price is the most you pay. Returns an id straight away; call get_result with it until the file is ready. A local file needs upload_asset first.

mode.description: Video templates only. "remix" (default) = make a new video like the template, from your pictures and prompt. "recast" = keep the template's moves and swap who is in it for your image_urls.

prompt.description: Product ads: an optional change to the ad ("make it a winter sale"). Video templates: remix = your version of the template's prompt (leave out to use the template's own); recast = what to change.

pictures.description: Video template remix: one picture per slot, keyed by the slot name from list_templates (e.g. {"him": "https://…"}).

image_urls.description: Video template recast: photos of who should appear in the clip.

product_image_url.description: Product ads: a photo of your product, uploaded with upload_asset. Talking head: optional, shows the product on camera.

script.description: Talking head: what the person says, word for word. Podcast: one line per turn, written "Name: what they say", the names exactly as in people. Everything must fit one 30 s take.

place.description: Talking head: where they are, in a few words, e.g. "a small Paris hotel room with a tall window".

people.description: Talking head: one person. Podcast: two hosts, the first sits on the left.

name.description: What the script calls them, e.g. "Mia". Plain first names work best.

image_url.description: A clear photo of their face. A public link — upload_asset gives one for a local file.

look.description: Optional. Age, hair and outfit in a few words, e.g. "30s, short dark hair, green jacket". Leave out to keep what the photo shows.

setup.description: Talking head on the plain template: how it is filmed — "selfie" (default), "propped" or "friend".

resolution.description: Leave out for the template's own default. 480p costs less.

dry_run.description: true = only check the request and return the price in credits. Nothing is made, nothing is spent.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string you make up for this request. Retry with the same key and you get the first result back instead of paying again.

callback_url.description: Optional. A public https:// link. When the job finishes (done, failed or canceled) we POST the finished result here, signed. See the docs for checking the signature. Polling get_result still works.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: The templates run_template can run, each with its id, kind (product_ad, video_template, talking_head, podcast), the inputs it takes and a rough price. Free.

tools.name: get_result
tools.title: Get a result
tools.description: Status and file of something you made. When status is SUCCEEDED, output.url is the finished file — show that link to the user. FAILED carries the reason in error.message. Still running? Wait 15-30 s and call again; video takes 1-10 minutes.

id.description: The id a make/edit/recast call returned

tools.name: list_results
tools.title: List recent results
tools.description: The user's most recent results, newest first, with their file URLs.

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.title: Upload a file
tools.description: Get a URL diffusr can read for a picture, clip or audio file. Free. LOCAL file, any size → pass content_type and the EXACT size_bytes; you get upload_url and a ready curl command. PUT the file there (run the curl if you have a shell, otherwise give it to the user), then use file_url. ONLINE image or short clip → pass source_url. A large online video can time out that way: download it and upload it as a local file instead. Limits: images 25 MB, video 250 MB, audio 50 MB — compress or trim anything bigger first. Uploads are inputs: kept 7 days after a job last used them (24 h on test keys), then deleted.

source_url.description: A public http(s) URL to copy in. Use this OR the three fields below.

content_type.description: For a LOCAL file: its MIME type, e.g. "video/mp4", "image/jpeg".

size_bytes.description: For a LOCAL file: its exact size in bytes.

tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: Only needed to pick a specific model — every tool already has a good default. Shows each model's aspect ratios, lengths, resolutions, reference limits and price per second or image in credits.
